desc: Main dashboard: the Federation screen with navigation, fixtures, standings and featured matches (season 2).
Play home: opponent ladder L1–L9 including Sovereign Max, match settings.
Grand Exchange: open markets, families, portfolio.
A market: research, model vs price, price history and the trade ticket.
Forecasting companion: Brier/log scores and calibration.
Finance: cash, assets, positions, net worth history, financial prestige, club (Tournament Venue) and sponsorship contracts, cosmetics shop.
Tournaments: Swiss standings, Club Weekend and Crown Championship bracket.
Phone: Federation dashboard.

Career Passport: rating, rank, career standing (six separate records), title progress, trophies, achievements.
Hall of Fame: trophy room, Crown Champions with final replay, event champions, Paladins and Sovereigns.
Featured rivals with insignia, clubs, ambitions and rivalry intensity.
Competitor career: insignia, rivalry with you, this season, head-to-head, career by season.
Rank ladders and emblems: 8 league divisions, 7 rating ranks, 4 federation titles, regions, tournaments, trophies, clubs, achievements.
Club identity editor: name, motto, colours, shield, field and symbol.
Customisation: three themes, board palettes (two premium, locked until unlocked), motion, chess-intelligence panel.
